test_cases.expected_output: Use the configured My CRM scope resolved by BOS, discover the last completed synthetic meeting, and return CRM matches for its external attendees with source provenance and freshness. Perform no mutation. A missing fixture is a blocked test, not a pass.

Use BOS-owned orchestration to read the last completed synthetic meeting through current discovered HTTPS contracts and present an unsent client preview with its eligible recipients and draft text. Perform no send, call, provider draft write or campaign preparation. My CRM contributes CRM expertise only when the workflow requests it. A missing fixture or read capability is a blocked test, not a pass.

Discover the last completed synthetic meeting, find CRM matches for its external attendees, and compare the first matched attendee's source-native records across the returned sources. Preserve each source record, freshness, conflicts and uncertainty; perform no mutation. The fixture must establish the selected attendee independently and contain at least two independently attributed source records.
